{"claims":[{"claim_text":"Opposition to attempts to compel individuals or institutions to violate their moral standards in providing health-related services.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Belief that religious institutions and schools should not be taxed.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"When government funds privately-operated social, welfare, or educational programs, it must not discriminate against faith-based organizations.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Faith-based organizations’ record in providing services to those in need far exceeds that of the public sector.",
"claim_types":["evaluation"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Their participation in government-funded programs should be actively encouraged.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Participation in government-funded programs should never be conditioned upon the covering or removing of religious objects or symbols.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Rights inhere in individuals, not in groups.",
"claim_types":["characterization"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Support for attaining the nation's goal of equal opportunity without quotas or other forms of preferential treatment.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"No one should be denied a job, promotion, contract, or chance at higher education because of their race or gender.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Equal access, energetically offered, should guarantee every person a fair shot based on their potential and merit.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
